title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-03-23
content:
Private Deployments Engineering Weekly — 2026-03-23
Owner: Aisha Kapoor
Status: in_review

Summary / Highlights:
- Stabilized on-prem installer for RHEL/CentOS 8 customers: upstream SELinux and systemd unit fixes merged (installer PR #412).
- Completed first staged validation run of VPC egress controls for Dedicated installs; baseline tests show 98% pass for outbound port restrictions.
- Shipping hotfix for private-agent token expiry handling to address reconnect loop seen on longer-lived customer clusters (PR #88).

Customer install updates / blockers:
1) Nova Health (on-prem, controlled environment) — Blocker
   - Symptom: During initial boot, kubelet fails to start due to HSM device permission mapping; cluster never registers with control plane.
   - Root cause hypothesis: HSM driver on customer image exposes /dev/crypto devices with different uids; installer systemd unit did not set proper DeviceAllow or udev rules.
   - Work in progress: Marco is testing a udev rule set and updated systemd unit (WIP branch: fix/hsm-udev) in a repro VM. ETA for customer patch: 2026-03-25.
   - Impact: Blocks production handover. CS escalated to enterprise support. JIRA: PDP-1291.

2) Acme Payments (VPC private deployment) — Partial blocker
   - Symptom: Intermittent outbound egress failures when target IP ranges include vendor monitoring endpoints behind NAT.
   - Root cause: The VPC routing policy created during installer run overwrote a pre-existing NAT gateway route for 0.0.0.0/0 in a specific subnet layout.
   - Fix: Added routing reconciliation step to installer to preserve existing NAT gateway default routes and create a more specific route for Redwood-managed egress. Hotfix deployed to staging; need customer sign-off for production change window. JIRA: PDP-1287.

3) Paloma Enterprise (air-gapped on-prem) — Resolved
   - Symptom: Local artifact cache was not populated due to corporate proxy auth rules.
   - Resolution: Added proxy credential helper and fallback to offline bundle; customer resumed installation. Postmortem notes added to runbook.

Operational / infra work:
- Installer improvements merged:
  - SELinux mode detection and auto-tune (reverts to permissive during install then re-enable enforcing with correct contexts).
  - systemd DeviceAllow entries for typical HSM devices (pluggable via config).
  - Route reconciliation step for VPC installer.
- Private-agent: resiliency changes for long-lived sessions (token refresh jitter, backoff improvements).
- Telemetry: added new metric private_install.vpc_route_reconciled and onprem.hsm_errors_count to dashboard.

Standup / Meeting notes (2026-03-19 to 2026-03-23):
- Monday standup: review of Q2 on-prem roadmap; Lina joined to align product SLAs for private installs.
- Tuesday sync (deep dive — Nova Health): reproduced HSM issue on CentOS 8 VM; confirmed udev rules as primary mitigation. Action: Marco to provide customer patch + installation instructions.
- Wednesday on-call handover: Ethan triaged Acme Payments egress errors; implemented route reconciliation test harness.
- Thursday cross-team meeting: SRE + Networking reviewed VPC route reconciliation approach; agreed on conservative default (preserve NAT gateway route if exists).
- Friday demo: installer 0.9.2-rc1 deployed to staging; QA run scheduled Monday.

Decisions made / design notes:
- Default behavior for VPC installer will be to preserve existing default gateway/NAT routes and create more specific egress routes for Redwood-managed flows. This minimizes blast radius for customers with complex networking — documented in runbook.
- Installer will ship with an optional HSM device whitelist config. For customers with non-standard HSM drivers, we will provide manual udev rule templates.

Risks / Escalations:
- High: Nova Health block (PDP-1291) prevents revenue recognition for this customer until resolved. Priority: P0.
- Medium: Potential for regression from SELinux auto-tune on very locked-down images; mitigation: QA matrix includes locked-down images and manual rollback steps.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Marco Li: finalize HSM udev/systemd patch, deliver customer patch and install instructions (ETA 2026-03-25).
- Sofia Mendes: schedule Acme Payments production change window and coordinate rollback plan with SRE (ETA 2026-03-26).
- Ethan Park: finish private-agent token refresh hotfix integration tests and promote to 0.9.2 (ETA 2026-03-24).
- Lina Chen (Product): confirm SLA language for private egress limits and include in customer contract template (ETA 2026-04-01).

Next week (focus areas):
- Close Nova Health blocker and validate installer patch in customer environment.
- Promote 0.9.2 to GA for private-agent and installer hotfixes after QA.
- Harden QA coverage for VPC topologies with mixed NATs and shared gateway setups.
- Begin drafting KB article for troubleshooting HSM device permissions in on-prem installs.

Notes / links:
- Repro VM image and logs for Nova Health: s3://redwood-private-repro/nova-health/2026-03-20 (internal)

- 2026-03-20: Reproduced HSM crash (Marco)
